figures.caption: Table 1: Simulation performance metrics across nuisance-model specification scenarios. Target parameter is QTE(0.5), true value is 5.9. Each scenario was evaluated using 1,000 simulation replicates. Sample size is 1,000. OR: outcome regression. PS : propensity score. Var : empirical variance over 1,000 simulation replicates. RMSE : root mean squared error. MedAE : median absolute error.

Figure 1: Estimated marginal and conditional distributional treatment effects of INSTI-based versus non–INSTI-based regimens on 6-month CD4 cell count. The top panels display the quantile treatment effect (QTE) as a function of the quantile level, while the bottom panels show the probability treatment effect (PTE) as a function of the CD4 threshold. The left panels present marginal effects (green), and the right panels present sex-specific conditional effects, with red lines corresponding to females and blue lines corresponding to males. Shaded bands represent 95% bootstrap percentile confidence intervals.
Table 2: Empirical standard deviations, estimated standard errors, and 95% confidence interval coverage for QTE(0.5) under different variance estimators and nuisance-model specifications.
